var a = [10]
let previous = a
a = push(20, a)
a = push(30, a)
let readers = map((x) => () => x, a)
let values = map((f) => f(), readers)
assert(previous == [10])
assert(values == [10, 20, 30])
assert(findIndex((x) => x > 15, values) == 1)
print(jsonStringify(values))
